name: Proto Sum
source:
Invited to a place beneath the earth known only as the Facility, you are asked to debug a prototype AI - but not told what it will be used for. What will you teach it? The future may ride on your choices.

- Teach the prototype how to view the world. But be careful...
- Multiple outcomes. Can you get the true ending?
- A "programming" clicker mini-game.
- A mysterious purpose waiting to be unraveled.

[From [url=https://ryngm.itch.io/proto-sum]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你受邀前往一处地下设施（Facility），参与调试一款原型AI，但对方没有告诉你它将被用于何处。你会教它如何看待世界？未来或许就取决于你的选择。

- 教原型学会如何观察世界，但务必小心……
- 多种结局。你能找到真结局吗？
- 一款关于“编程”的点击式小游戏。
- 等待揭开的神秘用途。

[摘自[url=https://ryngm.itch.io/proto-sum]Itch.io[/url]]
